title: 39th sitting of the 20th Majlis

items.text: Opening recitation (Hamd and Salawat); the sitting begins.
Roll call of members present at the sitting.
Announcement of the day's agenda (Agenda No. އޖ/39/2024).
Approval of the minutes of two previous sittings (minutes Nos. 34/2024 and 35/2024).

Question time: Vaikaradhoo MP Hussain Ziyad asks the Minister of Tourism, Ibrahim Faisal, whether the government plans to add tourist beds in HDh Atoll by the time the Hanimaadhoo International Airport (started under President Solih with Indian assistance) is completed, given the atoll has had no real tourism in half a century of Maldivian tourism.

From the Speaker's desk: the President's nominee for Deputy Commissioner General of Taxation (Tax Administration Act, Law No. 3/2010, Article 8(a)) is sent to the relevant standing committee for review.
First reading of the Bill amending the Tobacco Control Act (Law No. 15/2010), submitted on behalf of the government by Henveiru North MP Ahmed Aifan.
Foreign Relations Committee report on the President's request for Parliament's consent for the Maldives to join the International Atomic Energy Agency (IAEA).
Voting on items from the day's business that have reached the voting stage.

summary: The sitting approved old minutes, questioned the tourism minister on HDh Atoll, sent a deputy tax commissioner nominee to committee, introduced the Tobacco Control Act amendment, and took up a report on joining the IAEA.
